description: This file defines a React functional component named 'General' which composes various preference-related components within a preferences pane interface. It sets up the structure for a preferences UI section, passing application and controller props to child components.

classes.name: General
classes.description: A React functional component that renders a preferences pane with various settings and sub-sections related to user preferences.

methods.name: General
methods.description: React component that assembles various preference sections within a PreferencesPane. Uses props for application context and view controller management.
